title: Where are Argon games?
author: UnboundedMan
selftext: Has seriously no one made anything useful with this LLM yet?

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body:
gemmi variants are know to be buggy and way less reliable try it yourself not even with game dev but something lite . my test was a landing page claude made :-/ it failed so hard i just kept away. See no reason to go since llm break all the time i rather have one that breaks less. 

I think the need to shrink their context window and focus on prompt adherence

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body: It's not been an issue for me.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
Gemini models have historically been hot fckn garbage; it could well be that Argon is a massive improvement, but Google decided to show its whole ass early in the game and now is paying for that mistake.

You only get to launch once. It's Google - they know that rule, and they decided to ignore it. So now nobody cares about their model drops.

comments.author: evangelism2
comments.body: It's been like a week, chill.

comments.author: Dangerous_Three_8506
comments.body:
Its upsetting. I am looking too. There is a rome warrior game someone made comparing to Opus. It looked great. Don't ever listen to the haters of Gemini they are in the way of progress and not thinking smartly. Grok could release a new model tomorrow better than all the others and it will take a month to beat the Claude fan boys.

Idk if GPT has fanboys.

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body:
cmon bro, fan boying enegry around here fo sho , but atm its anthro then open, then idk who is in 3rd place it's been like that for awhile anthro has fable 5.5 and open idk they should have done a more powerful model on their dev day but apparently was banned and we got sol 6.1 instead. So yes they are still ahead of the pack. 

You can see here people try many models as a sort of rnd . No one who have used a multitude of models is sticking with gemmi unless they are a ultra fanboy , paid shill or have massive credits.

Gemmi sucks im not using this shit for anything it sucked a few years months back and after testing latest still is horse shit. That doesn't i wont test their later iterations

replies.author: Dangerous_Three_8506
replies.body:
I don't believe in your judgement. I think people don't know what they are doing with AI. I'm sure there are many like me where they are treating AI as a Gold Rush and not sharing what they find.

I plan on sharing once my game is released. I'll share all my techniques and make my whole study open source. I can't share today because someone will show up at "my gold site" with greater mining equipment. They have massive youtube channels, a game product already. I am not ready.

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body:
don't take my word for it ...never...but...check in the next few weeks how many people you see that answers OP question.... also read the last line i will test their later iterations , we are using ai to do more work / faster work and or supplement a deficit and in many cases an entire skill set .So most of us are not loyal to a model because something better is always there.  

And yes i do share workflows , i even share others workflows with the post for people experience an issue i experience and saw a solution. 

Will i open source my solutions...no but i will tell how to arrive there

replies.author: Dangerous_Three_8506
replies.body: Right on. I need a fan base before I share. I need money, I'm making video games into my job till the day I die.

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: You seriously underestimate how much time it takes to make a game. I got agron cause google pro is $5 a month for three months and used the weekly agron quota to fix a single bug. I’ve needed 7 months of $20 Claude usage to make 1 of 6 floors, I assume $100 agron plans don’t have too much agron usage either. It just hasn’t been enough times. But argon seems fully capable.
